scientific_integrity: The inherited junction energy and qualitative exponential localization are acknowledged as published prior work. Exact subdivision transformations might implicitly cover some of the new quantitative conclusion; no independent audit or external originality certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unit-hopping edge subdivision only, for finite connected simple \(d\)-regular parent graphs with fixed integer degree \(d\ge3\); no irregular or disordered models, magnetic phases, interactions, or infinite-volume periodic spectra. The error is uniform in parent size, not in unbounded degree.
title: Uniform spectral fingerprint of the junction band in long edge-subdivided regular networks
